column1: radical§The radical proposal of 1971 is the settled practice of today, and nobody remembers who fought it.§1971 年那项**激进的**提案是今天的既定做法，而没人记得当年谁反对过它。§radic（根，同 radish 萝卜）→ 从根子上改
raid§The raid recovered four hundred documents, and the case that followed rested on nine of them.§这次**突击搜查**取得四百份文件，随后的案子建立在其中九份之上。§
raiment§The inventory lists his raiment in four lines and his books in nine pages.§这份财产清单用四行列出他的**衣物**，用九页列出他的书。§array（装扮）→ 穿戴之物
ramble§He rambled for twenty minutes and then said, in one sentence, the thing everyone had come to hear.§他**东拉西扯**了二十分钟，然后用一句话说出了所有人来听的东西。§
rambunctious§The rambunctious first years settled down by March, and the teacher who managed it was twenty-three.§那些**闹腾不听管的**新生到三月就安分了，而管住他们的老师二十三岁。§
ramshackle§The ramshackle shed housed nine years of records, and one storm destroyed all of them.§这间**摇摇欲坠的**棚屋存放着九年的记录，一场风暴把它们全毁了。§ransack（洗劫）→ 被翻得散架
rancor§The rancor between the two departments predates every person now working in either of them.§两个部门之间的**积怨**比如今在职的任何一人资历都久。§ranc（腐臭）→ 心里发酸发臭
rancorous§The rancorous exchange lasted four minutes and is the only part of the debate anyone quotes.§这段**恶语相向的**交锋持续四分钟，也是这场辩论唯一被引用的部分。§
rapport§Her rapport with the patients was the reason four of them told her what they had told nobody else.§她与病人之间的**融洽关系**，是其中四人把从没告诉别人的事告诉她的原因。§
rapturous§The rapturous reviews of the first night were written before the second act had been rewritten.§首演之夜那些**欣喜若狂的**评论，是在第二幕被重写之前写的。§rapt（抓走，同 rapture 狂喜）→ 被夺了魂
rashly§He acted rashly on information that turned out, four days later, to be entirely wrong.§他**轻率地**依据一条信息行动，而四天后证明它完全错了。§
ratify§Nine countries ratified the treaty in the first year and four have still not done so.§九个国家在第一年**批准**了这份条约，另有四国至今未批。§rat（计算／确认，同 rate 比率）
rational§The decision was rational given what they knew, and what they knew was wrong in four particulars.§就他们所知而言这个决定是**理性的**，而他们所知在四个细节上是错的。§ratio（计算，同 ratio 比率）
rationalism§The rationalism of the founders sits oddly beside the fact that four of them consulted astrologers.§创始人们的**理性主义**与其中四人求问占星师这一事实并列，颇为古怪。§
rationality§Rationality is not the same as being right, and the four decisions in question were rational and wrong.§**理性**不等于正确，而讨论中的这四个决定既理性又错误。§
rationalization§The rationalization came afterwards, and the file shows the decision was taken in about nine minutes.§这套**事后合理化的说辞**是后来才有的，卷宗显示决定约在九分钟内做出。§
rationalize§He rationalized the delay in four paragraphs and never once mentioned the actual reason.§他用四段文字为这次延误**找了理由**，一次也没提真正的原因。§
raze§The council razed nine streets to build a road that carries about four hundred cars a day.§议会**夷平**九条街来修一条日均通行约四百辆车的路。§ras（刮，同 erase 擦除）
reactionary§The reactionary wing won four seats and set the agenda for the next nine years.§这个**保守反动的**派系赢下四个席位，为此后九年定下了议程。§re（回）+ act（行动）→ 往回拉
reactive§The department is reactive rather than preventive: nine of its ten programmes begin after harm is done.§这个部门是**被动应对的**而非预防性的——十个项目中有九个在伤害发生后才启动。§
reaffirm§The court reaffirmed a principle that at least four lower courts had quietly stopped applying years ago.§法院**重申**了一项至少四家下级法院多年前就已悄悄不再适用的原则。§re（再）+ affirm（确认）
realign§The company realigned four divisions into two and lost nine of its most experienced managers.§公司把四个事业部**重组**为两个，失去了九位最有经验的经理。§re（再）+ align（对齐）
realistic§The realistic estimate was ignored in favour of one that made the deadline look achievable.§那个**切合实际的**估算被弃之不用，取而代之的是让期限看着可行的那个。§
realization§The realization came four years too late, and by then the collection had been sold in nine lots.§这份**领悟**晚了四年，那时藏品已分九批售出。§
reap§They reaped the benefit of a decision taken by people who never saw any of it themselves.§他们**收获**了一个决定的好处，而做决定的人自己什么也没得到。§
reappraise§The gallery reappraised the painting in 1994, and its value fell by about ninety percent overnight.§画廊在 1994 年**重新评估**了这幅画，其价值一夜间跌去约九成。§re（再）+ appraise（估价）
rearrange§Rearranging the four desks did more for the team's output than nine months of software did.§把四张桌子**重新摆一下**对团队产出的作用，超过九个月的软件投入。§
reassure§Nothing reassured the residents until an engineer they trusted walked the site with them.§直到一位他们信任的工程师陪他们走过现场，居民才**安下心来**。§re（再）+ assure（保证）
rebate§The rebate is worth four hundred pounds and requires nine pages of paperwork to claim.§这笔**退款**值四百英镑，要填九页表格才能申领。§re（回）+ bate（减少，同 abate 减弱）
rebel§Four members rebelled against a leadership that had not consulted them in nine months.§四名成员**反抗**了一个九个月没征询过他们意见的领导层。§re（反）+ bel（战争，同 bellicose 好战的）
rebellion§The rebellion lasted nine weeks and changed a tax that four decades of petitions had not touched.§这场**叛乱**持续九周，改变了四十年请愿都没能撼动的一项税。§
rebellious§The rebellious chapter was cut from the first edition and restored, uncut, in 1994.§那**叛逆的**一章在初版中被删，1994 年原样恢复。§
recalcitrance§The recalcitrance of one department delayed a change that the other nine had already made.§一个部门的**顽抗**拖延了另外九个部门早已完成的改动。§re（回）+ calcitr（踢）→ 尥蹶子
recalcitrant§The recalcitrant valve was replaced four times before anyone examined the pipe behind it.§那个**不听使唤的**阀门被换了四次，才有人去检查它后面的管子。§
recant§He recanted in 1633 and, according to four contemporaries, went on believing exactly what he had said.§他在 1633 年**公开翻悔**，而据四位同时代人所记，他仍旧相信自己说过的话。§re（回）+ cant（唱，同 chant 吟诵）→ 把话唱回去
receptivity§The receptivity of the audience surprised her: nine questions, and none of them hostile.§听众的**接受度**让她意外——九个问题，没有一个带敌意。§recept（接收，同 receive 接收）
recessive§The trait is recessive, which is why it appears in about one child in four and skips whole generations.§这个性状是**隐性的**，所以它约每四个孩子出现一个，还会跳过整代人。§re（回）+ cess（走，同 recede 后退）→ 退到后面
reciprocate§The gesture was never reciprocated, and the two departments stopped speaking for nine years.§这份善意从未得到**回报**，两个部门九年不相往来。§re（回）+ pro（向前）→ 来而有往
reclaim§The town reclaimed four hectares of marsh in 1908 and has been pumping the water out ever since.§这座小镇 1908 年**开垦**了四公顷沼泽，此后一直在抽水。§re（回）+ claim（喊／要求）
reclusive§The reclusive author gave four interviews in forty years and answered every letter she received.§这位**隐居的**作家四十年只接受四次采访，却回复了收到的每一封信。§re（回）+ clus（关闭，同 include 包括）→ 把自己关起来
recognition§Recognition came nine years after the work and four years after the money would have helped.§**认可**在工作完成九年后到来，比钱能派上用场的时候晚了四年。§re（再）+ cogn（知道，同 cognition 认知）
recollect§She could recollect the room, the weather, and four sentences of a conversation from 1962.§她能**回忆起**1962 年的那个房间、那天的天气，还有对话中的四句。§re（再）+ collect（收集）→ 把记忆重新收拢
recommence§Work recommenced on the tunnel in April after a nine-month pause that nobody has yet satisfactorily explained.§隧道工程在停工九个月后于四月**重新开工**，而这次停工至今无人给出满意解释。§re（再）+ commence（开始）
recommendation§The recommendation was accepted in principle and, four years later, has not been implemented.§这项**建议**原则上被接受，四年后仍未实施。§
reconcile§Nobody could reconcile the two sets of figures, and the difference is about four hundred thousand.§没人能**调和**这两套数字，差额约四十万。§re（再）+ concil（召集，同 council 议会）
reconciliation§The reconciliation took nine years and began with a letter neither of them ever mentioned again.§这次**和解**用了九年，起于一封两人此后再没提起的信。§
reconstituted§The reconstituted committee had four new members, a new chair, and reached exactly the same conclusion.§**重新组建的**委员会有四名新成员、一位新主席，得出的却是完全相同的结论。§re（再）+ constitute（构成）
recourse§Their only recourse was a tribunal that meets four times a year and had a nine-month backlog.§他们唯一的**申诉途径**是一个每年开四次会、积压九个月案子的仲裁庭。§re（回）+ curs（跑，同 current 水流）→ 跑回去求助
recrimination§The recriminations lasted longer than the project, and four people left rather than take part.§**互相指责**持续得比项目还久，四个人宁可离职也不参与。§re（回）+ crimin（指控，同 crime 罪）
recruit§They recruited nine people in four months and lost four of them within the first year.§他们四个月**招募**了九个人，第一年内就走了四个。§re（再）+ cru（生长，同 crescent 新月）→ 补充新血
rectitude§His rectitude was inconvenient for everyone, and it is the reason the accounts survive at all.§他的**正直**让所有人不便，也正是账目得以留存的原因。§rect（正直，同 correct 正确的）
redeem§One clear chapter redeems a book that spends four hundred pages avoiding its own subject.§一个清晰的章节**挽回**了一本用四百页回避自身主题的书。§re（回）+ em（买，同 exempt 豁免）→ 赎回来
redemptive§The redemptive ending was added by the publisher, and the manuscript stops nine pages earlier.§这个**救赎式的**结尾是出版社加的，手稿在九页前就结束了。§
rediscover§Every generation rediscovers the same four techniques, gives them new names, and believes it invented them.§每一代人都**重新发现**同样的四种技法，给它们起新名字，并相信是自己发明的。§re（再）+ discover（发现）
redolent§The workshop is redolent of linseed oil, and four visitors in ten say it reminds them of childhood.§这间工作室里**满是**亚麻籽油的气味，十位访客中有四位说它让他们想起童年。§red（回）+ ol（气味，同 odor 气味）
redouble§They redoubled the search after the fourth day and found the wreck within nine hours.§第四天后他们**加倍**搜寻，九小时内找到了残骸。§re（再）+ double（加倍）
redundancy§The redundancy is deliberate: four independent systems, and the aircraft flies safely on any one.§这种**冗余**是刻意的——四套独立系统，飞机靠任何一套都能安全飞行。§red（再）+ und（波浪，同 abundant 丰富的）
redundant§Nine of the eleven paragraphs are redundant, and the two that matter are on the last page.§十一段里有九段是**多余的**，要紧的两段在最后一页。§
refine§They refined the method over four years, and the final version takes nine minutes instead of a day.§他们用四年**改进**了这个方法，最终版本只需九分钟而非一天。§re（再）+ fine（精细）
reflective§The most reflective passage in the memoir is about a decision he made in about four seconds.§这本回忆录里最**深思的**一段，讲的是他约四秒钟做出的一个决定。§re（回）+ flect（弯曲，同 flexible 灵活的）
refract§Water refracts light enough that a straight pole looks broken at the surface, which fooled fishermen for centuries.§水对光的**折射**足以让一根直杆在水面处看着是断的，这骗了渔民几个世纪。§re（回）+ fract（折断，同 fracture 骨折）
refund§The refund finally arrived nine months later, without interest, and only after four separate written requests.§这笔**退款**九个月后才终于到账，没有利息，此前还寄了四次书面申请。§re（回）+ fund（倒／基金）
refurbish§They refurbished four wards and left the ventilation, which was the actual problem, untouched.§他们**翻新**了四个病区，却没动通风系统——而那才是真正的问题。§re（再）+ furbish（擦亮）
refutation§The refutation was published nine years later in a journal that four people read.§这篇**驳论**九年后发表在一本四个人读的期刊上。§
refute§One experiment refuted a theory that had generated four hundred papers over thirty years.§一个实验**驳倒**了一套三十年间催生四百篇论文的理论。§re（回）+ fut（打击）→ 打回去
regal§The regal manner did not survive her first winter in a flat with four other students.§这种**帝王般的**做派，没能挺过她与另外四名学生合租公寓的第一个冬天。§reg（国王，同 regime 政权）
regenerate§The liver regenerates to about ninety percent of its mass within four months of surgery.§肝脏在术后四个月内**再生**到约九成的质量。§re（再）+ gener（产生，同 generate 生成）
